name: Ten Pao Group Holdings Limited
summary: Ten Pao Group Holdings Limited, founded in 1979 and based in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company that designs, makes and sells electrical charging and power supply products worldwide. Its six segments are telecommunications, media and entertainment, home appliances, lighting, smart chargers and controllers, and others. Products include fast and wireless chargers, power adapters, LED power supplies and EV charging infrastructure, and it also trades audio devices and offers building decoration services.
